thread.title: UBS Maintains Their Buy Rating on Apple (AAPL)

author: Carrie Williams
title: UBS Maintains Their Buy Rating on Apple (AAPL)
text:
By Carrie Williams
UBS analyst Timothy Arcuri maintained a Buy rating on Apple ( AAPL – Research Report ) on December 11 and set a price target of $210 . The company’s shares closed yesterday at $169.10.
According to TipRanks.com , Arcuri is a top 100 analyst with an average return of 24.1% and a 66.3% success rate. Arcuri covers the Consumer Goods sector, focusing on stocks such as Applied Materials Inc, Skyworks Solutions, and Texas Instruments.
The word on The Street in general, suggests a Moderate Buy analyst consensus rating for Apple with a $224.88 average price target, representing a 33.0% upside. In a report issued on November 26, Loop Capital Markets also maintained a Buy rating on the stock with a $225 price target.
